authority: Owner requested incorporation of repository-review recommendations and implementation order; pending implementation ownership is unchanged.
dependency_semantics: Acceptance prerequisites for the listed output, not hard-start dependencies between entire tracks; preparation may proceed within an assigned scope. Canonical per-arm prerequisites still apply.

steps.exit: Canonical validator and renderer agree on valid, unknown-source, duplicate-ID and illegal-transition fixtures; compatibility and view controls preserved.
Current D0 contract A0-A5 accepted by the existing coordinator with fresh worker-head evidence.
Bounded extraction preserves offsets, identity, polarity, units and ambiguity; exact source and grouped-split contracts pass.
Event, recording and recipient-availability intervals preserve conflicts, unknowns and partial order.
Decision-time packet and concern trace pass permitted-view tests across retrieval, caches, verification and rendering.
Relevant D4 arms, availability study and scoring have frozen family splits, matched comparisons, failures and case-clustered uncertainty; no all-abstain winner.

Included components pass claim, omission, correction propagation and final-render checks; actual isolation evidence precedes sensitive execution. Generative arms additionally require their semantic-verifier and model qualification.

additional_conditions: Current owner handoffs for any AcciMap or HEAPS view included
steps.exit: Selected packet reproduces complete, incomplete and conflicting cases and preserves evidence changes, concerns, actions, unsupported items and correction burden.

additional_conditions: Frozen eligible external or temporal holdout
Appropriate observations for each claimed workflow outcome
steps.exit: Publish exact-task qualification or rejection with useful coverage, material/severe errors, omissions, false blocking, resource cost and clustered uncertainty.

steps.preferred_investment_order: Larger empirical extensions follow promising comparative evidence; this is not a universal D7 acceptance gate.
additional_conditions: Each selected arm consumes its canonical leaf prerequisites; independent adapters may be implemented and accepted earlier
CAW16 needs accepted CAW02/04/08/10; CAW17 consumes CAW16; CAW19 also needs CAW07
FAW20 requires a measured bottleneck and parity/resource evidence, not completed D7
CAW23 requires its conventional/untuned/verifier comparisons and residual error evidence
CAW24 consumes CAW14/22; formal value of information additionally needs an admitted decision model
Action-effectiveness and replication claims require their own data, follow-up and reference-result evidence
steps.exit: Accept or reject the bounded process, evidence-acquisition, action-effectiveness, replication or adaptation hypothesis without blocking the simpler product.

parallel_owner_handoffs.condition: Synthetic structural graph independent of automatic extraction; stronger claims consume relevant accepted D1-D3 components.
Local-template conformity unresolved until evidenced; public/synthetic work may proceed; AcciMap optional.
Source reconciliation and fixture design may proceed; unresolved authority blocks only affected profile rules.

optional_paths.trigger: Demonstrated document/OCR/modality need; qualification required only when included.
Distinct predeclared study question and admitted resources; no blanket dependency for the deterministic product.
